metadata.source: U.S. EPA AirToxScreen 2020 (block-level results, gaftp.epa.gov/rtrmodeling_public/AirToxScreen/2020), aggregated to 2020 census tracts; geometry from data/acs.geojson
metadata.notes: Screening-level modeled estimates. cancer_risk_per_million = population-weighted mean over the tract's populated 2020 blocks of EPA's total lifetime cancer risk (sum of all source types incl. secondary formation and background; diesel PM not included). respiratory_hi = population-weighted sum of EPA exposure concentration / RfC over EPA's respiratory-endpoint air toxics (computed here; EPA has not published 2020 HI files). Percentiles rank the tract among populated tracts (US = 50 states + DC).
